card.title: Journal locked
card.body: Your reflections are private. Unlock with your fingerprint or screen lock.

insight.label: Low Power Mode
insight.text: Low-output log (60 XP). Whether today was rest, friction, or just life happening off-screen, the slate resets on the next dial.
insight.pattern: Pattern noticed: 100% of your XP over the last 2 weeks was logged between 5 AM and 11 AM. Put your hardest block there.

prompt.text: If a good friend had the exact day you just had, what would you tell them tonight?

reflect.placeholder: How did today feel? What mattered? What will you do differently?

counter.old: Reflections on older days earn no XP
